newsitem.title: USA: US LPG market steady, propane imports to Dow.
newsitem.headline: US LPG market steady, propane imports to Dow.

text.p: U.S. spot liquefied petroleum gas prices were largely steady midday Thursday although Conway, Kansas, propane was up on demand, players said.
Conway propane rose about a half cent to between 37.50 cents and 37.75 cents a gallon as dealers bought up small parcels in a market with few sellers.

Spot material in the U.S Gulf Coast, Mont Belvieu, Texas, hub were unchanged at 35.75/36.00 cents. Players said the market was nervous about which direction crude might take after the Memorial Day weekend.
"Everyone is nervous about crude. It has a history of dumping after the holiday," said a Houston trader.
Meanwhile, an international player said three cargos of propane have been contracted to arrive at Dow. Two were from Venezuela to dock in May and in June and one was from Sonatrach to arrive in June.
-- Laney Salisbury, New York Energy Desk, 1 212 859 1631
